services.name: Event Venue Rentals
services.desc: Create an unforgettable gathering at the Northwest Museum of Arts and Culture, one of Spokane’s most distinctive event venues. From open-air weddings and receptions to corporate celebrations, performances, and private events, the MAC offers flexible indoor and outdoor spaces framed by striking contemporary architecture, thoughtfully curated exhibitions, and sweeping views over Peaceful Valley and the Spokane River. Guests enjoy free onsite parking and an atmosphere unlike any traditional hotel or conference venue.
